run_simple_inference: run the RecurrentGemma model with debug config or preset 2B model for inference
create_griffin_config: create a GriffinConfig with custom vocab size, width, lru width, and block types for debug mode
build_griffin_model: build a Griffin model instance from a GriffinConfig for JAX-based recurrent inference
test_model_init_prefill: test model initialization and prefill forward pass with random tokens and segment positions
save_model_tensors: save model parameters, config, tokens, and sampled outputs via Orbax checkpoint
